race.comment: Good race. LINEBACKER (11) multiple Group winner well placed for this with his sound second up record. Like the way he attacked the line first up when fourth in the G3 Bill Ritchie Handicap at Randwick over this trip. Since fitted with a 1030m trial placing and drops in weight. Respect. HEADLEY GRANGE (2) won this race last year from a wide gate and gets better with age. Second up he shouldered the 61kg for a tough third over 1400m in the G3 Bill Ritchie Handicap. Hyeronimus sticks and he looks to get the right set-up. GRINGOTTS (1) has finished runner-up in this race the last two years. No Autumn Glow to contend with today and looks to be on track for another tilt at The Big Dance. Place preferred. SEPALS (5) Group 1 winner unlucky not to win the G1 Stradbroke Handicap and G1 Sir Rupert Clarke Stakes at his last two outings. Can hold a forward position from the awkward draw and figure prominently. GENERAL SALUTE (4) backed up the two good trials with a sharp win in the Bill Ritchie.
